automated.summary: ASKFLOOR-1-T3c automated proof: the twelve required leaves (one through the general integration config against gantry_test with GANTRY_TEST_DATABASE_URL exported — the default Postgres lane deliberately excludes the worker-coordination suite — and eleven unit) ran through the exact-leaf JUnit gate on the host and pass; npx tsc --noEmit and npm run check:architecture pass; python3 factory/scripts/verify.py passed WITH GANTRY_TEST_DATABASE_URL exported (format, architecture, typecheck, the full unit suite of 9,150 tests, the serial general integration lane). The first host verify had 47 regressions from one unconditional updatePendingInteractionPayload call in the prompt binding; fixed at the root (batch bindings finalize only members that carry a remember context; context-less prompts take today's path) and re-verified. Ceilings: types.ts 740/740, inline 749/750, IPC 851/865. Sandbox: 197 focused + 263 regression tests green; the Postgres leaf is host-run (EPERM in the sandbox).
commands_run: VITEST_JUNIT=1 npx vitest run -c vitest.unit.config.ts apps/core/test/unit/application/permission-remember-codec.test.ts -t "round-trips the four remember codes and the three scalar modes and returns null for anything else" --outputFile=.tmp-junit/leaf-0.xml

VITEST_JUNIT=1 npx vitest run -c vitest.unit.config.ts apps/core/test/unit/application/human-decision-learning.test.ts -t "derives a remember context whose provisional eligibility holds only for an interactive_auto lane with a person and no scheduled job, whose exact, category-kind and tool-kind candidates equal a fresh derivation including each typed refusal reason, resolves a place code to no_root, encodes a deny with kind or place scope to null, parses every malformed context field class to null with no learning while the scalar result settles, and learns from it by picking the candidate for the resolved scope with kindVariant choosing between the two kind candidates, relaying every service refusal, and returning unlearned without throwing when the port fails" --outputFile=.tmp-junit/leaf-1.xml

VITEST_JUNIT=1 npx vitest run -c vitest.unit.config.ts apps/core/test/unit/application/human-decision-memory-service.test.ts -t "rememberDerived writes the same row as remember for the same key and relays the same refusals" --outputFile=.tmp-junit/leaf-2.xml

VITEST_JUNIT=1 npx vitest run -c vitest.unit.config.ts apps/core/test/unit/runtime/ipc-interaction-handler.test.ts -t "persists the remember context before delegating to the durable flow on both the denylist and classifier-ask prompt exits with a lane and effect hash equal to the helper's and a person id and label from the same host source that no callback identity overrides and an undefined label when the host source has none, still recovers a context after a crash between the provider claim and the helper returning, persists an eligible remembered Allow once before the current call is applied once-only with unchanged events, persists a remembered No with the current call denied, persists nothing for an ask, auto_strict, group, batch or scheduled-job prompt, a blank person, or a persisted context whose lane input re-derives outside interactive_auto, and treats a provider double-delivery as already decided with zero writes" --outputFile=.tmp-junit/leaf-3.xml

VITEST_JUNIT=1 npx vitest run -c vitest.unit.config.ts apps/core/test/unit/bootstrap/inline-agent-loop-tools.test.ts -t "persists an eligible remembered Allow once from the after-decision hook on a non-scheduled auto run with the person id and label from the run's host identity and an undefined label when the run has none, persists nothing on a scheduled run, and leaves the decision applied when the memory port fails" --outputFile=.tmp-junit/leaf-4.xml

VITEST_JUNIT=1 npx vitest run -c vitest.unit.config.ts apps/core/test/unit/application/pending-interaction-permission-recovery-orchestrator.test.ts -t "recovers a persisted remember code into the identical mode and remember intent and learns once from the persisted context before applying, rejects an unauthorized tapper before the claim with no write and no application, settles an authorized code on an ineligible card as its scalar base once with no write, treats a replayed callback on a settled claim as already decided, learns on recovery after a crash before learning, and ends with one active row after a crash after learning" --outputFile=.tmp-junit/leaf-5.xml

VITEST_JUNIT=1 npx vitest run -c vitest.unit.config.ts apps/core/test/unit/application/pending-interaction-durability.test.ts -t "round-trips the remember context through the durable member payload, turns it ineligible when the binding is a batch, and returns context and decoded resolution through the single settlement accessor by claim and by recovery" --outputFile=.tmp-junit/leaf-6.xml

VITEST_JUNIT=1 npx vitest run -c vitest.integration.config.ts apps/core/test/integration/worker-coordination.postgres.integration.test.ts -t "stores a raw remember code on the durable claim and refuses an unknown claim mode or rendered option on read" --outputFile=.tmp-junit/leaf-7.xml

VITEST_JUNIT=1 npx vitest run -c vitest.unit.config.ts apps/core/test/unit/channels/provider-affordance-parity.test.ts -t "round-trips all four remember codes and all three scalar modes through the Telegram and Slack codecs including Slack action-id registration and the Telegram 64-byte maximum" --outputFile=.tmp-junit/leaf-8.xml

VITEST_JUNIT=1 npx vitest run -c vitest.unit.config.ts apps/core/test/unit/storage/runtime-store.test.ts -t "wires the production learn dependency over the decision-memory repository into the durable callback path" --outputFile=.tmp-junit/leaf-9.xml

VITEST_JUNIT=1 npx vitest run -c vitest.unit.config.ts apps/core/test/unit/control/session-interaction-approvals.test.ts -t "renders a remember code as its scalar base in the control API and rejects a code on its POST" --outputFile=.tmp-junit/leaf-10.xml

VITEST_JUNIT=1 npx vitest run -c vitest.unit.config.ts apps/core/test/unit/runtime/askfloor-tap-budget.test.ts -t "S2 taps at most once with a remembered exact Allow on the first run through the real claim, learning and application path and zero times on the second identical run through the real coordinator" --outputFile=.tmp-junit/leaf-11.xml
